title: Detect Anything in Graphic Design: Element-Level Rewards for Autoregressive Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.07072v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graphic designs, such as posters, advertisements, and infographics, are an important medium for communicating information and shaping understanding. Unlike natural images, they consist of layered elements with explicit compositional order. However, existing object detection models treat these elements as an unordered set, leaving compositional order unexploited. To address this limitation, we present Detect Anything in Graphic Design (DAD), a model that formulates graphic design detection as compositional deconstruction. It decodes elements in compositional order, using lower-layer elements to better detect higher-layer ones. The key feature of DAD is amodal detection, which predicts the full bounding box of each element, including regions occluded by elements placed above it. Building on this formulation, we propose Element Relative Policy Optimization (EleRPO), which extends GRPO from sequence-level supervision to element-level optim

translated_title: 图形设计中的万物检测：面向自回归检测的元素级奖励
translated_abstract: 海报、广告和信息图表等图形设计是传递信息和塑造认知的重要媒介。与自然图像不同，它们由具有明确组合顺序的分层元素构成。然而，现有的目标检测模型将这些元素视为无序集合，未能利用组合顺序信息。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了 Detect Anything in Graphic Design (DAD)，一个将图形设计检测建模为组合解构的模型。它按照组合顺序解码元素，利用较低层的元素来更好地检测较高层的元素。DAD 的关键特性是非模态检测，即预测每个元素的完整边界框，包括被其上层元素遮挡的区域。基于这一框架，我们提出了元素相对策略优化，将 GRPO 从序列级监督扩展到元素级优化……
tldr: 提出 DAD 模型，将图形设计检测建模为按组合顺序解码的组合解构，实现能预测被遮挡完整边界的非模态检测，并提出将 GRPO 扩展至元素级奖励的 EleRPO 方法。
en_tdlr: DAD formulates graphic design detection as compositional deconstruction with amodal detection of occluded full bounding boxes, and introduces EleRPO, which extends GRPO from sequence-level supervision to element-level rewards.
